svg.aria-label: Original electron-optical and preparation concepts. A connects to magnetic-lens imaging in 1931; B shows a bright-field aperture accepting near-axis electrons and blocking off-axis electrons; C explains how vitrification developed in the 1980s enabled frozen hydrated observation. Schematics are not to scale.
